# Liza Holiarchuk — Event Photographer Hamburg

> Event photographer based in Hamburg, working across Germany and Europe. Focus: trade shows, conferences and corporate events. Half day (up to 4 h) from €1,200, full day (up to 8 h) from €1,800, social clip €450 (all prices net, plus VAT).

- 5+ years in event photography, previously worked in event organisation
- Same-day first photos possible, full gallery usually within 48 hours
- Partner photographers in Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Vienna, Zurich, Stockholm and Tallinn
- Working languages: English and German
- Address: Roggenkamp 4, 22305 Hamburg, Germany
- Contact: hello@lizaholiarchuk.com, +49 175 260 6697

The website is bilingual: German at the root, English under /en.

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en): Overview of services, clients, packages and FAQ
- [Home (German)](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/): Startseite auf Deutsch
- [Pricing](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/pricing): Packages and prices — half day, extended (up to 6 h, from €1,600), full day, multi-day, video options ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/preise))
- [Contact](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/contact): Inquiry form, email and phone ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/kontakt))

## Services

- [Trade show photographer](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/trade-show-photographer-hamburg): Booth coverage, visitor interactions, product shots and team photos at Hamburg Messe and trade fairs across Europe ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/messefotograf-hamburg))
- [Conference photographer](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/conference-photographer-hamburg): Keynotes, panels, networking and audience at B2B conferences in Hamburg and across Europe ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/konferenzfotografie-hamburg))
- [Corporate event photographer](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/corporate-event-photographer-hamburg): Awards nights, internal events, company anniversaries and executive gatherings ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/corporate-event-fotograf-hamburg))
- [Event photographer](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/event-photographer-hamburg): B2B conferences, trade shows and corporate events in Hamburg and across Europe ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/eventfotograf-hamburg))
- [Christmas party photographer](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/christmas-party-photographer-hamburg): Corporate Christmas parties in Hamburg, up to 4 hours from €1,200 ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/weihnachtsfeier-fotograf-hamburg))
- [Video support](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/en/video-support): Two video options — social clip filmed on a smartphone and delivered the next day (€450), or event video with a videographer (quoted per project) ([German](https://www.event-fotografin-hamburg.de/video-support))
